brief.t: START HERE: Put Roon Body's ready 2,000-unit run onto the production schedule and give Josh a firm start and completion date now.

ACT NOW 1: Josh confirmed PLL has all 2,000 tubes and bottom stickers, while Roon Body remains backlogged across inventory. His written recap is 1 calendar day old and he also needs a mid-November slot for the next 10,000 units. Send: Josh, I am locking the 2,000-unit run into the floor schedule this morning and will send you the firm start and completion dates, plus the mid-November 10,000-unit slot, today.

ACT NOW 2: Polo container EMCU8614105 has been at Price Transfer pending customs exam since October 10, now 6 calendar days. Gaby asked Aidan to check back October 15, but no clearance or release update is visible. Send: Gaby, please confirm whether EMCU8614105 has cleared the exam, whether it is available for release, and the earliest pickup time today.

ACT NOW 3: Marcello requested 500 additional TALOVA lip balms after a stockout and proof of delivery for the prior 15,000 units. No later resolution is visible 7 calendar days later. Send: Marcello, I am confirming stock or build timing for the additional 500 and proof of delivery for the prior 15,000 now. I will give you both answers today.

next: Recommendation: Commit Roon Body's production dates first, then close the Polo customs exam and TALOVA stockout.

Displaced: Tocopherol moved below Act Now because its COA remains unverified, but no specific live production run was confirmed against it; Roon Body has all inputs on site and a documented inventory backlog.

Scheduled: 11 other operational items. Bulk Naturals order 99139 is out for delivery today; Roon Body's inbound 10,000 tubes are ready for freight pickup, and FedEx shipment 533066816125 is due October 19.
Noise: 50+ Outlook messages were below the operational cutoff.

Source gaps: CRM and WhatsApp browser sessions are signed out. Purchasing returned no current records to rule out additional supplier, QC, inventory, or lead-time risks. The Email lane did not return a fresh update within the run window. Missing data is not zero.
signal: Roon Body has all inputs on site and needs production dates. Polo's container remains pending customs exam. TALOVA's stockout and prior delivery remain unresolved.
redflags: Roon Body is backlogged while the ready 2,000-unit run has no verified floor dates.
EMCU8614105 has been at Price Transfer pending customs exam for 6 calendar days.
TALOVA's additional 500-unit need and prior 15,000-unit delivery remain unverified 7 calendar days after the request.
noise: 50+ Outlook messages were below the operational cutoff; the October 15 result set hit the 50-message cap, so this is a minimum rather than a complete count.
